sayLines.text: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Somchai speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Union Rep is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

🔥 Elijah takes up a brand and Kayden follows — they meet it at the edge of the light with noise and fire. The Union Rep was never brave. It melts back into the dark. (The watch drove off the feast's scavenger. The devotion stays armed; the feast's fire still burns in you.)

Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Sofia.
🧳 Thornfield has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Their speaker is dead. Haven installs its own at Stonebridge's table — the empire's manners. Tribute rises to 6,000 kcal/week. They grieve; the link holds.
